cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The hall rejected our wedding booking. Apparently we're meant to marry somewhere less municipal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every venue is booked for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then September gives us three more months to practise being married.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My parents can't travel in September.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we go to them. Their garden! We're finally finding out where this wedding belongs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've brought tissues. Being laid off together doesn't make your day any easier.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're wiping your eyes on your sleeve.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'm saving the soft ones for you. Tell me what you're worried about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You. You can't even get the tissue box open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take the whole box. I'll make tea once my hands stop doing this.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

cards.title: Emotional Interest
cards.instruction: Treat comfort, vulnerability, and forgiveness as investments that must eventually be repaid with equal emotional risk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I told your mother I'm scared she dislikes me. Sunday, you owe me an equally embarrassing admission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to tell her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I trusted you to risk something too. What scares you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That she'll like you more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's equal. Now tell her over lunch. Mine had an audience; yours needs one too.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll talk about last night's rent argument, but not the whole year tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The whole year matters. You've been pulling away.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Were you going to move out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I packed a bag. It's still upstairs. Please let that be the whole answer for a minute.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: B

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You ended your message with 'take care.' That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring you soup tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're at the final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

beats.text: I've only cancelled lunch. I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what he said before seeing me became another job.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then? I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He chose a restaurant too. Public enough that I couldn't beg. Book the corner, please.
